sideB.text:
ANTANANARIVO

Black city art with a white upgrade panel and a green ring. No other text.

rules: The white center panel is the infection-card upgrade slot. The green ring is standard infection-card art.
notes: Printed P7-17b. Card 18 is a second copy of this same face and is also printed P7-17b.
Goes to the reserve when the package is opened.
